newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Spain's Bilbao Vizcaya takes stake in Ganadero.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Bilbao Vizcaya takes stake in Ganadero.

text.p: Spain's Banco Bilbao Vizcaya bought 425 million ordinary shares in Colombia's Banco Ganadero at a previously agreed price of 295 pesos per share, Bogota stock brokers said.
They said the 125.3 billion peso deal was part of Bilbao Vizcaya's previously agreed purchase of a 40 percent stake in Gandero, Colombia's largest bank in terms of assets.
A total of 449 million ordinary shares were up for sale at Tuesday's public offer, but brokers said Bilbao Vizcaya had limited its purchase to 425 million.
The bank's ordinary shares closed at 287 pesos per share on the Bogota stock market on Tuesday.
